basic_details.job_title: Nuh District Court Stenographer Grade III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District and Sessions Judge, Nuh has invited applications from the general public for 08 posts of Stenographer Grade-III, purely on adhoc basis in Nuh Sessions Division, at a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,500/-. Applications must reach the office of The District and Sessions Judge, Nuh, by registered post or by hand, by 25 November 2026 up to 5:00 P.M.; applications received after that will not be entertained.

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 years. The upper age limit is in accordance with the latest instructions of the Haryana Government, calculated as on 01.01.2026. For candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste and Backward Class-A and B of Haryana State, and persons already in Government employment, the upper age limit is such as may be fixed by the Haryana Government from time to time. Applications of underage or overage candidates will be deemed to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: About Nuh District Court Stenographer Grade-III
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of District and Sessions Judge, Nuh, Haryana, which handles the courts of Nuh Sessions Division. The posts are filled for a period of six months or till regular appointments are made by the Hon'ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana, Chandigarh, whichever is earlier. Selection is made strictly under Rule 7 of the Haryana Subordinate Courts Establishment (Recruitment and General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1997.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Address the application to "The District and Sessions Judge, Nuh" and send it to the office of The District and Sessions Judge, Nuh, either by registered post or by hand. It must reach the office by 25 November 2026 up to 5:00 P.M. No advance copy will be entertained, and applications sent through e-mail will not be accepted in any case. The form's subject line reads: "Application for the post of Stenographer on adhoc basis."

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 08 posts are of Stenographer Grade-III on adhoc basis, at a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,500/-. The category-wise break-up is as printed in the notice: The number of vacancies may increase or decrease. If candidates of a reserved category are not available, the posts may be filled from candidates in the unreserved category, subject to their availability, in terms of the explanation to Rule 7 of the Haryana Subordinate Court Establishment (Recruitment and General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1997. A degree of Bachelor of Arts or Science or equivalent thereto from a recognized University. Passed matriculation examination with Hindi as one of the subjects. Proficiency in operation of Computers. The minimum age is 18 years. The upper age limit is in accordance with the latest instructions of the Haryana Government, calculated as on 01.01.2026. For candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste and Backward Class-A and B of Haryana State, and persons already in Government employment, the upper age limit is such as may be fixed by the Haryana Government from time to time. Applications of underage or overage candidates will be deemed to be rejected. The posts carry a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,500/-. The appointment is purely adhoc, initially for a period of six months or till regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier. For any other eligibility detail, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: One latest passport size photograph affixed on top of the application. Attested copies of relevant certificates/testimonials. Attested copy of the category certificate issued by the Competent Authority, if a category is claimed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates must qualify the English Shorthand Test and its Transcription, and a Computer Proficiency Test. The English Shorthand Test and its Transcription are at a speed of 80 w.p.m. and 20 w.p.m. respectively, on Computer. The stenography test will be held on 30 November 2026, and candidates must report sharp at 10:00 AM with their own shorthand note book and pencil. Candidates also have to qualify a Computer Proficiency Test. The notice also refers to a computer typing test. The place of examination will be informed on the website http://districts.ecourts.gov.in/mewat , and no separate letter or call letter will be issued. Candidates should watch the public notice on the notice board of the Court of the District and Sessions Judge, Nuh, and the same website. Original testimonials and identity proof must be brought at the time of the tests. No TA/DA will be given for appearing in the tests.

faq.question: Q1. How many Stenographer Grade-III vacancies are there in Nuh District Court?
faq.answer: There are 08 posts: General 3, Deprived SC 1, BC-A 2, ESM (BC-B) 1 and EWS 1. The number may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Nuh District Court Stenographer application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office of The District and Sessions Judge, Nuh, by 25 November 2026 up to 5:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A degree of Bachelor of Arts or Science or equivalent from a recognized University, matriculation passed with Hindi as one of the subjects, and proficiency in operation of Computers.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years, and the upper age limit is as per the latest Haryana Government instructions, calculated as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Stenographer Grade-III here?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,500/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application on plain paper or the prescribed form, with a photograph and attested certificates, to The District and Sessions Judge, Nuh, by registered post or by hand.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply by e-mail?
faq.answer: No. Applications sent through e-mail will not be accepted in any case, and no advance copy will be entertained.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates must qualify the English Shorthand Test and Transcription at 80 w.p.m. and 20 w.p.m. respectively on Computer, and a Computer Proficiency Test.

faq.question: Q9. When is the stenography test?
faq.answer: The stenography test is on 30 November 2026, with reporting sharp at 10:00 AM; the venue will be informed on http://districts.ecourts.gov.in/mewat.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely adhoc, for six months or till regular appointments are made by the Hon'ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana, whichever is earlier.
